mapper.sql: regexp_replace( lower(concat_ws('|', coalesce(s.table_title, ''), coalesce(s.row_key, ''), coalesce(s.row_path, ''), coalesce(s.row_leaf, ''), coalesce(s.source_locator, '') )), '[[:space:] /／!！_|:：;；,，.。()（）－—-]+', '' )

regexp_replace( lower(concat_ws('|', coalesce(s.table_title, ''), coalesce(s.column_key, ''), coalesce(s.column_path, ''), coalesce(s.column_leaf, ''), coalesce(s.source_locator, '') )), '[[:space:] /／!！_|:：;；,，.。()（）－—-]+', '' )

regexp_replace( lower(concat_ws('|', coalesce(s.table_title, ''), coalesce(s.row_key, ''), coalesce(s.row_path, ''), coalesce(s.column_key, ''), coalesce(s.column_path, ''), coalesce(s.value_text, ''), coalesce(s.normalized_value, ''), coalesce(s.source_locator, '') )), '[[:space:] /／!！_|:：;；,，.。()（）－—-]+', '' )

regexp_replace( lower(concat_ws('|', coalesce(table_title, ''), coalesce(table_profile_id, ''), coalesce(row_key, ''), coalesce(row_label, ''), coalesce(row_path, ''), coalesce(column_key, ''), coalesce(column_label, ''), coalesce(column_path, ''), coalesce(value_text, ''), coalesce(normalized_value, ''), coalesce(value_signature, ''), coalesce(cell_coordinate, ''), coalesce(source_locator, ''), coalesce(locator_method, '') )), '[[:space:] /／!！_|:：;；,，.。()（）－—-]+', '' )

choose.otherwise: concat( coalesce(nullif(row_key, ''), nullif(row_label, ''), nullif(row_path, ''), ''), '|', coalesce(nullif(column_key, ''), nullif(column_label, ''), nullif(column_path, ''), '') )
concat( coalesce(nullif(r.row_key, ''), nullif(r.row_label, ''), nullif(r.row_path, ''), ''), '|', coalesce(nullif(r.column_key, ''), nullif(r.column_label, ''), nullif(r.column_path, ''), '') )

choose.when: case when max(coalesce(r.runtime_match_count, 0)) > 0 then true else false end as runtime_recognized, case when max(coalesce(r.runtime_match_count, 0)) > 0 then 'MATCHED' else 'MISSING_MATCH' end as runtime_status, cast(max(coalesce(r.runtime_match_count, 0)) as signed) as runtime_match_count, max(r.runtime_side) as runtime_side, max(r.runtime_title) as runtime_title, max(r.runtime_detail) as runtime_detail, max(r.runtime_locator) as runtime_locator, max(r.runtime_value_text) as runtime_value_text, max(r.runtime_confidence_level) as runtime_confidence_level, max(r.runtime_source_artifact) as runtime_source_artifact, max(r.runtime_locator_method) as runtime_locator_method
choose.otherwise: false as runtime_recognized, 'NO_RUNTIME' as runtime_status, 0 as runtime_match_count, null as runtime_side, null as runtime_title, '未选择 runtime，暂不判断运行过程是否识别' as runtime_detail, null as runtime_locator, null as runtime_value_text, null as runtime_confidence_level, null as runtime_source_artifact, null as runtime_locator_method

sql.if: left join ( select match_key, runtime_side, count(*) as runtime_match_count, max(concat(coalesce(table_title, '未命名表'), ' / runtime ', level)) as runtime_title, max(concat( '行：', coalesce(nullif(row_label, ''), nullif(row_key, ''), nullif(row_path, ''), '未识别行名'), '；列：', coalesce(nullif(column_label, ''), nullif(column_key, ''), nullif(column_path, ''), '未识别列名'), '；值：', coalesce(nullif(value_text, ''), nullif(value_signature, ''), '空') )) as runtime_detail, max(coalesce(nullif(cell_coordinate, ''), nullif(source_locator, ''), nullif(locator_method, ''))) as runtime_locator, max(coalesce(nullif(value_text, ''), nullif(value_signature, ''))) as runtime_value_text, max(confidence_level) as runtime_confidence_level, max(source_artifact) as runtime_source_artifact, max(locator_method) as runtime_locator_method from ( select as match_key, runtime_side, table_title, level, row_label, row_key, row_path, column_label, column_key, column_path, value_text, value_signature, cell_coordinate, source_locator, locator_method, confidence_level, source_artifact from runtime_structure_item where project_id = #{projectId} and run_id = #{runId} and note_no = #{noteNo} and level = #{level} ) runtime_base group by match_key, runtime_side ) r on r.match_key = and r.runtime_side = s.side

mapper.sql: left join structure_gt_decision d on d.project_id = s.project_id and d.decision_key =

left join structure_note pdf_note on pdf_note.project_id = s.project_id and pdf_note.note_no = s.note_no and pdf_note.side = 'PDF' left join structure_note excel_note on excel_note.project_id = s.project_id and excel_note.note_no = s.note_no and excel_note.side = 'EXCEL'

order by coalesce( min(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then st.table_order end), min(case when s.side = 'PDF' then st.table_order end), 2147483647 ), coalesce( min(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then s.row_order end), min(case when s.side = 'PDF' then s.row_order end), 2147483647 ), item_key

max(d.decision) as decision, max(d.comment) as decision_comment, max(d.alias_text) as alias_text, max(d.merge_target_key) as merge_target_key, max(d.reviewer) as reviewer, max(d.reviewed_at) as reviewed_at, max(d.updated_at) as decision_updated_at

coalesce(max(case when s.side = 'PDF' and s.source_locator is not null and s.source_locator != '' then concat('/preview-assets/', #{projectId}, '/pdf/', md5(substring_index(s.source_locator, '!', 2)), '.png') end), max(case when pdf_note.source_locator is not null and pdf_note.source_locator != '' then concat('/preview-assets/', #{projectId}, '/pdf/', md5(substring_index(pdf_note.source_locator, '!', 2)), '.png') end)) as pdf_preview_url, coalesce(max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' and s.source_locator is not null and s.source_locator != '' then concat('/preview-assets/', #{projectId}, '/excel/', md5(s.source_locator), '.png') end), max(case when excel_note.source_locator is not null and excel_note.source_locator != '' then concat('/preview-assets/', #{projectId}, '/excel/', md5(excel_note.source_locator), '.png') end)) as excel_preview_url
mapper.select:
select #{projectId} as project_id, #{noteNo} as note_no, #{level} as level, coalesce(src.source_total_count, 0) as source_total_count, coalesce(src.pdf_count, 0) as pdf_count, coalesce(src.excel_count, 0) as excel_count, coalesce(src.both_side_count, 0) as both_side_count, coalesce(src.pdf_only_count, 0) as pdf_only_count, coalesce(src.excel_only_count, 0) as excel_only_count, coalesce(src.runtime_matched_count, 0) as runtime_matched_count, coalesce(src.runtime_missing_count, 0) as runtime_missing_count, coalesce(runtime_only.runtime_only_count, 0) as runtime_only_count from (select 1) seed left join ( select count(*) as source_total_count, sum(has_pdf) as pdf_count, sum(has_excel) as excel_count, sum(case when has_pdf = 1 and has_excel = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as both_side_count, sum(case when has_pdf = 1 and has_excel = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as pdf_only_count, sum(case when has_pdf = 0 and has_excel = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as excel_only_count,
sum(case when runtime_match_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as runtime_matched_count, sum(case when runtime_match_count = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as runtime_missing_count
0 as runtime_matched_count, 0 as runtime_missing_count
from ( select as match_key, max(case when s.side = 'PDF' then 1 else 0 end) as has_pdf, max(case when s.side = 'EXCEL' then 1 else 0 end) as has_excel,
count(distinct r.id) as runtime_match_count 0 as runtime_match_count
from s
left join runtime_structure_item r on r.project_id = s.project_id and r.run_id = #{runId} and r.note_no = s.note_no and r.level = #{level} and r.runtime_side = s.side and =
where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo} group by match_key ) grouped_source ) src on 1 = 1 left join (
select count(*) as runtime_only_count from ( select distinct runtime_base.runtime_side, runtime_base.match_key from ( select runtime_side, as match_key from runtime_structure_item where project_id = #{projectId} and run_id = #{runId} and note_no = #{noteNo} and level = #{level} ) runtime_base left join ( select distinct s.side, as match_key from s where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo} ) source_keys on source_keys.side = runtime_base.runtime_side and source_keys.match_key = runtime_base.match_key where source_keys.match_key is null ) runtime_only_grouped
select 0 as runtime_only_count
) runtime_only on 1 = 1

from structure_row s left join structure_table st on st.id = s.table_id
where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo}

from structure_column s
where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo}
and ( s.table_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_leaf like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.source_locator like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')

from structure_cell s
where s.project_id = #{projectId} and s.note_no = #{noteNo}
and ( s.table_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.row_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.row_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.column_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.value_text like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.normalized_value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.source_locator like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
or like concat('%', #{normalizedKeyword}, '%')
